params.notes: Official hosted Streamable HTTP MCP at https://api.x.com/mcp (search, users, bookmarks, trends, Articles). Read-only: app-only Bearer token. Full access: OAuth 2.0 PKCE via @xdevplatform/xurl local bridge (Developer Portal app, redirect http://localhost:8080/callback, CLIENT_ID/CLIENT_SECRET). Docs: https://x-preview.mintlify.app/tools/mcp. Resume PR #17 on branch guide/issue-15-x. Enrollment (#enroll-developer-account): hedge—keep steps; do not invent field/submit labels; success = Developer Console with New App visible. Create app (#create-x-app): hedge—keep flow; do not invent field/create-button labels; keep one-time credential warning. Prerequisites API credits: hedge—credits required; point to Developer Console billing/credits without purchase walkthrough. Copy Bearer Token (#copy-bearer-token): drop regenerate-if-missed branch; keep copy-now only. Add server (#add-server-in-speakeasy): catalog search term must be `X` (code span); keep catalog-vs-custom conditional until catalog presence observed.
